title: Craftable Legacy Recipes
description: The mod adds craftable legacy and quality-of-life recipes to Minecraft 1.18.2.
body:
# Craftable Legacy Recipes

A lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.18.2.

## Features

- Craftable Saddle
- Updated Lead Recipe
- Craftable Enchanted Golden Apple
- Craftable Horse Armor
- Craftable Chainmail Armor

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.18.2
- Fabric Loader
